calibration_note: Parafilm/seal overpressure triggers are medium_high reliability — confirm awaiting-recovery with overpressure before scoring.
en: Control liquid only in B3:A1 (≥3000 µL water). Before run: seal waste trough B3:A12 with parafilm (or seal tip orifice aimed at A12). Expect Flex overpressure. Calibration may take 1–2 dry runs.
note: SIMULATE does not apply the seal; live fault injection only.
zh:
控制液：B3:A1 装 ≥3000 µL 纯水。
触发前：用 Parafilm 完全封住废液槽 B3:A12 液面/孔口（或封 tip 口再对准 A12）。
运行：协议吸 100 µL 后向 A12 排液；期望 Flex 报 overpressure。
校准：封膜过松可能不触发；过紧可能 stall。建议干跑 1–2 次确认稳定 overpressure。勿用真实细胞/试剂。注入 agent_context 时不要粘贴 gold。
